note: The arrangement's hygiene at every house-v2 position the producer does not arrange (PLAN-UNIFY U1: §1.8 the long-hold fade, §1.17 the gap filler), each knob in the unit it declares (src/musical-time.ts) and leaned by the one lean (src/lean.ts). The fast places keep their own numbers in the producer's row (`holds`, `arc.filler`), which resolve to the same rule. A repair, not a layer: a hold is faded only where it would stop (it ends while the music goes on, nothing harmonic takes over within a felt beat, and its own release is shorter than the fade it wants), and a bed is laid only where the groove would go bare (nothing harmonic, melodic or textural over the drums and the bass: a sparse texture, a struck bell or a marimba, is present). Every number is a starting point for listening.

units.says: what each knob counts (src/musical-time.ts): bars are the theme's written grid, felt beats its felt pulse; seconds and dB are absolute; a share is 0 to 1; a lean is the one lean's

holds.says: a held chord or pad of `leastS` or more that ends while the music goes on, with nothing harmonic struck within `handoverFeltBeats` of its end and a release shorter than its fade, fades over its last stretch (squared, as the fast places' holds: some 12 dB down halfway) and rings on past its written end by `tailShare` of the fade where nothing harmonic follows. The fade is `fadeBars` bars held between `fadeLeastS` and `fadeMostS` seconds (2 s at 174 BPM, 3.4 s at 105, 5 s at 50), then leaned by Tide (a wetter field lets a hold ring longer: x0.71 at nought, x1.41 at one). From `leastBpm` up only: the slow side's cut notes are its own way of delivering pads (his ear, 10-13); and never on a scene `skipScenes` names, where the held layer in front is the drone (his ear, 10-13: keep the combo). A struck texture (a bell, a marimba: the `texture` and `detail` roles) decays in its own envelope and is not a hold

gaps.says: a quiet bed where the groove (a main, a drop or a build, the drums or the bass playing, after the theme's first harmony) would go bare for more than `emptyBars` bars or `emptyMostS` seconds, whichever is shorter (4 bars at 174 BPM, 8 s at the house and the slow side), where nothing holds the space: no harmonic, melodic or textural note, no moving bass line (`bassMoves` pitches in the bar) and no ticking hats (`hatsLeast` in the bar), for a break of bass and hats is a solid break (his ear, 10-13): the theme's own held chord over the chord in force (the nearest one it struck over that chord), `levelDb` under it, swelling in over `attackS` from the bar before the bare run, at most `fillerBars` bars and never across a chord change, faded out as a long hold is; at least `leastBars` bars or none. Nothing is laid where the theme struck no held chord over that chord
